heading: Hi, I'm Kidus.
story: I've been drawing and making things since I was a kid. A graphic design course in high school turned that into a direction, architecture school stretched it into space and structure, and now I work full time in the design industry.
approach: I work through curiosity, pulling different fields together until I get where I want to be. That doesn't mean heads down all day, every day. I leave space to wander off and get inspired by what I live and what I see.
